source='''def transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    for r, row in enumerate(grid):\n        if any(v in (2, 8) for v in row):\n            for c, value in enumerate(row):\n                height = {2: 4, 8: 3}.get(value, 0)\n                if height:\n                    top = r - height\n                    if top >= 0:\n                        out[top][c] = value\n                        for rr in range(top + 1, r):\n                            out[rr][c] = 1\n            break\n    return out\n'''
